prompts.pl:
Use case: infographic-diagram / ads-marketing.
Create a finished premium editorial infographic for the open-source RPG campaign planning web application Narrative Framework, for social media. Portrait 4:5 composition, ideally 1080x1350 or a proportional high-resolution canvas. Flat full-bleed artwork, NOT a photograph of a poster, no mockup frame.
Brand: light ivory #f8f8f3 background, deep forest ink #1c302b, restrained rust #a33e24 accent, subtle sage #d9ddd4 rules. Clear modern sans-serif with large readable headings, generous margins. Confident practical tabletop RPG tone. Custom charming restrained editorial illustrations of an innkeeper, a small timber inn, notebook notes and a relationship map, finely drawn ink with flat sage/rust fills. No purple, gradients, glow, stock dashboard, generic feature card grid, QR codes, dice decoration, invented logos or UI screenshots.
Composition: brand name small at top, strong left-aligned two-line headline below. Main middle area is an unmistakable top-to-bottom FOUR-STEP journey linked by one continuous thin rust path, each step with large number, short heading and concise caption next to an illustrative vignette. The final vignette is a clean graph with EXACTLY TWO labeled nodes (innkeeper and inn), and ONE directed arrow FROM the innkeeper TO the inn, labeled with their relationship. No other nodes or arrows in final graph. The first steps show a campaign notebook, then two separate small entry notes/illustrations, then drawing that relationship, then the connected map. Arrows signify relationships, not geographic travel. Avoid tiny illegible text and unnecessary ornament.
Bottom: short useful benefit sentence, understated Open Source + PL / EN line and prominent narrativeframework.com URL. All provided text must be spelled exactly including diacritics. Do not add unsupported claims about AI, speed guarantees, auto generation, pricing or user numbers. Do not add other text.
Language: Polish. Exact text:
Brand: "Narrative Framework"
Headline: "Od pomysłu\ndo mapy kampanii"
Intro: "Twój świat RPG. Twoje powiązania."
Step 1 heading: "Nazwij kampanię"
Step 1 caption: "Zacznij od własnego świata."
Step 2 heading: "Dodaj postać i miejsce"
Step 2 caption: "Nazwa i jedno zdanie wystarczą."
Step 3 heading: "Połącz je po swojemu"
Step 3 caption: "Mira → pracuje w → Karczma"
Step 4 heading: "Zobacz swoją mapę"
Step 4 caption: "Kliknij wpis, by wrócić do jego opisu."
Final graph nodes: "Mira", "Karczma"
Final graph arrow label: "pracuje w"
Bottom benefit: "Rozwijaj kampanię między sesjami."
Bottom small: "Open Source · PL / EN"
URL: "narrativeframework.com"

Language: English. Exact text:
Brand: "Narrative Framework"
Headline: "From an idea\nto your campaign map"
Intro: "Your RPG world. Your connections."
Step 1 heading: "Name your campaign"
Step 1 caption: "Start with your own world."
Step 2 heading: "Add a character and place"
Step 2 caption: "A name and one sentence are enough."
Step 3 heading: "Make your own connection"
Step 3 caption: "Mira → works at → The Inn"
Step 4 heading: "See your map"
Step 4 caption: "Click an entry to return to its description."
